source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
source.original_treatment_name: Garrya ovata Benth. subsp. lindheimeri (Torr.) Dahling

morphology_documented.habit: Dioecious evergreen shrub or occasional small tree 1–4 m tall
morphology_documented.leaves: Opposite, petiolate, entire; oblong-elliptic to ovate or obovate, 4.5–8 × 2.5–5 cm; lower face densely curled or crinkly pubescent, gray-white to gray-green
morphology_documented.flowers: Branched, fasciculate, hanging racemes; flowers lack petals; pedicellate staminate flowers with 4 stamens; pistillate flowers essentially sessile, with inferior ovaries
morphology_documented.fruit: Blue glaucous globose drupe 6–10 mm diameter
morphology_documented.habitat: Rocky slopes and bottoms in juniper-oak woodland, Edwards Plateau/Lampasas Cut Plain

source_scope_note: Historical species treatments and explicitly identified genus/key characteristics only; missing morphology not inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Flora places current indexed species under subspecies of G. ovata; modern taxon acceptance needs verification
Flora names Burnet and Williamson localities, not independently confirmed BONAP Hays distribution
preservation: Additive record only, original species and photo/credits/gallery unchanged
